scope:
Run built HAL boundary instructions and selected supplied-kernel paths.

Synthetic trap/PCR state; PIC end handler mocked. Stop BEFORE IRET. This is
not a guest boot, interrupt delivery, scheduler, or full hardware validation.

tests.test: EOI adapter discards C stack, installs ESP/EBP trap pointer and preserves frame
Clock adapter supplies EAX increment and native old-IRQL/vector stack for four levels
Public interrupt-end translates native vector argument to EBP frame and cleans 8 bytes
DPC wrapper preserves C nonvolatile registers despite native-helper clobbers
Trap entry handles kernel, user debug-off, user debug-on and V86 register-save cases
Actual installed NT5 EOI restores registers and exception chain up to IRET, kernel mode
Actual NT5 timer consumes increment, handles 64-bit carry, calls adapter and reaches EOI
Built IRQ0 entry and clock handler reach native EOI for accepted and spurious interrupts
